from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
import os

# Define output path
desktop_path = "C:/Users/achal/Desktop"
output_path = os.path.join(desktop_path, "India_Presentation.pptx")

# Create a presentation
prs = Presentation()

# --- Slide 1: Title Slide ---
slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[0] # 0 for title slide
slide = slide_layout.slides.add(prs)
title = slide.shapes.title
subtitle = slide.placeholders[1]

title.text = "भारत - एक परिचय"
subtitle.text = "विविधता में एकता (India - Unity in Diversity)"
title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(44)
subtitle.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(24)

# --- Slide 2: Geography ---
slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[1] # 1 for Title and Content
slide = slide_layout.slides.add(prs)
title = slide.shapes.title
content = slide.placeholders[1]
title.text = "भौगोलिक स्थिति (Geography)"
content.text = "भारत एक विशाल देश है जो दक्षिण एशिया में स्थित है।\n- हिमालय उत्तर में रक्षक के रूप में खड़ा है।\n- दक्षिण में हिन्द महासागर, पूर्व में बंगाल की खाड़ी और पश्चिम में अरब सागर है।\n- विविध भू-भाग: रेगिस्तान, मैदान, पठार और समुद्र तट।"
content.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(18)

# --- Slide 3: Culture ---
slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[1]
slide = slide_layout.slides.add(prs)
title = slide.shapes.title
content = slide.placeholders[1]
title.text = "संस्कृति और विरासत (Culture and Heritage)"
content.text = "भारत अपनी समृद्ध और विविध संस्कृति के लिए जाना जाता है।\n- अनेक भाषाएं, धर्म और परंपराएं।\n- शास्त्रीय नृत्य, संगीत और कला का केंद्र।\n- विश्व प्रसिद्ध व्यंजन और त्योहार (जैसे दिवाली, होली, ईद)।"
content.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(18)

# --- Slide 4: Economy ---
slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[1]
slide = slide_layout.slides.add(prs)
title = slide.shapes.title
content = slide.placeholders[1]
title.text = "अर्थव्यवस्था (Economy)"
content.text = "भारत दुनिया की सबसे तेजी से बढ़ती प्रमुख अर्थव्यवस्थाओं में से एक है।\n- सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी (IT) और सेवा क्षेत्र में वैश्विक नेतृत्व।\n- कृषि एक महत्वपूर्ण स्तंभ है।\n- 'मेक इन इंडिया' पहल के माध्यम से औद्योगिक विकास पर जोर।"
content.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(18)

# --- Slide 5: Conclusion ---
slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[1]
slide = slide_layout.slides.add(prs)
title = slide.shapes.title
content = slide.placeholders[1]
title.text = "निष्कर्ष (Conclusion)"
content.text = "भारत परंपरा और आधुनिकता का एक अनूठा मिश्रण है।\n- एक समृद्ध अतीत और उज्ज्वल भविष्य के साथ एक गतिशील राष्ट्र।"
content.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(18)


# Save the presentation
try:
    prs.save(output_path)
    print(f"Presentation saved successfully to {output_path}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error saving presentation: {e}")

import pptxgenjs
import os

def create_india_presentation():
    pres = pptxgenjs.Presentation()
    
    # Selecting a professional and vibrant theme
    # Using a modern minimal style with good color contrast
    
    # Slide 1: Title Slide
    slide = pres.add_slide()
    slide.background = {"fill": "003366"} # Deep blue background
    title = slide.add_text("Incredible India", {"x": 1.5, "y": 1.5, "w": 7, "h": 1, "font_size": 36, "color": "FFFFFF", "align": "center"})
    subtitle = slide.add_text("A Journey Through Diversity", {"x": 1.5, "y": 2.5, "w": 7, "h": 0.5, "font_size": 24, "color": "FED700", "align": "center"}) # Gold accent color

    # Slide 2: Diversity
    slide = pres.add_slide()
    slide.add_text("Unmatched Diversity", {"x": 0.5, "y": 0.5, "w": 9, "h": 0.5, "font_size": 28, "color": "000000"})
    content = """
    India is a land of vast cultural, linguistic, and geographical diversity.
    - **Culture:** Rich heritage, vibrant festivals, and ancient traditions.
    - **Languages:** Hundreds of languages and dialects spoken across the states.
    - **Geography:** From the Himalayas in the North to coastal beaches in the South, and deserts in the West.
    """
    slide.add_text(content, {"x": 0.5, "y": 1.5, "w": 9, "h": 4, "font_size": 18, "color": "333333"})

    # Slide 3: Key Highlights
    slide = pres.add_slide()
    slide.add_text("Key Highlights", {"x": 0.5, "y": 0.5, "w": 9, "h": 0.5, "font_size": 28, "color": "000000"})
    highlights = """
    - **Democracy:** The world's largest democracy.
    - **Economy:** Rapidly growing major economy and technological hub.
    - **Cuisine:** Diverse and celebrated worldwide.
    - **Monuments:** Home to wonders like the Taj Mahal.
    """
    slide.add_text(highlights, {"x": 0.5, "y": 1.5, "w": 9, "h": 4, "font_size": 18, "color": "333333"})

    # Slide 4: Conclusion
    slide = pres.add_slide()
    slide.background = {"fill": "003366"}
    slide.add_text("Experience Incredible India", {"x": 1.5, "y": 2.0, "w": 7, "h": 1, "font_size": 32, "color": "FFFFFF", "align": "center"})

    output_path = "C:/Users/achal/Desktop/India_Presentation_Revised.pptx"
    pres.save(output_path)
    print(f"Presentation saved to {output_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_india_presentation()

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
import os

def create_india_presentation_pptx():
    pres = Presentation()
    
    # Selecting a professional and vibrant theme with better contrast

    # Slide 1: Title Slide
    slide = pres.slides.add_slide(pres.slide_layouts[0])
    title = slide.shapes.title
    subtitle = slide.placeholders[1]
    title.text = "Incredible India"
    subtitle.text = "A Journey Through Diversity"
    
    # Customize title style (python-pptx theme customization is complex, applying basic formatting)
    title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(36)
    subtitle.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(24)


    # Slide 2: Diversity
    slide = pres.slides.add_slide(pres.slide_layouts[1])
    title = slide.shapes.title
    content_placeholder = slide.placeholders[1]
    title.text = "Unmatched Diversity"
    
    # Add content with better structure
    text_frame = content_placeholder.text_frame
    text_frame.clear()
    
    p = text_frame.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = "India is a land of vast cultural, linguistic, and geographical diversity:"
    p.font.size = Pt(18)
    
    p = text_frame.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Culture: Rich heritage, vibrant festivals, and ancient traditions."
    p.level = 1
    p.font.size = Pt(16)

    p = text_frame.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Languages: Hundreds of languages and dialects spoken across the states."
    p.level = 1
    p.font.size = Pt(16)

    p = text_frame.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Geography: From the Himalayas in the North to coastal beaches in the South."
    p.level = 1
    p.font.size = Pt(16)


    # Slide 3: Key Highlights
    slide = pres.slides.add_slide(pres.slide_layouts[1])
    title = slide.shapes.title
    content_placeholder = slide.placeholders[1]
    title.text = "Key Highlights"

    text_frame = content_placeholder.text_frame
    text_frame.clear()

    p = text_frame.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = "Driving Force:"
    p.font.size = Pt(18)

    p = text_frame.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "World's largest democracy."
    p.level = 1
    p.font.size = Pt(16)

    p = text_frame.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Rapidly growing major economy and technological hub."
    p.level = 1
    p.font.size = Pt(16)
    
    output_path = "C:/Users/achal/Desktop/India_Presentation_Revised_v2.pptx"
    pres.save(output_path)
    print(f"Presentation saved to {output_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    create_india_presentation_pptx()
